english.note: Use this with cases, incidents, or examples to mean a specific isolated occurrence rather than a general pattern.

examples.english: This power outage was just an isolated incident; it doesn't mean the whole district has a problem.
examples.traditional: 呢次停電只係個別事件，唔代表成區都有問題。
